caption: The drawing depicts two distinct metallic objects against a light, beige background. The object at the top is a handheld tool featuring a brown, textured handle that curves slightly at one end. Attached to the handle is a circular, spiked wheel or rotary blade with multiple pointed teeth, also rendered in shades of brown and grey, suggesting a metallic composition. Below this, the second object is a spur, consisting of a U-shaped frame with a rough, dark brown texture. At its center, a vertical bar extends upward and ends in a pointed tip, while the lower ends of the frame terminate in two round, flat disks or buttons on either side. The surface details and coloration of both objects display a worn, rusted appearance, emphasizing their metallic nature. The name "A. GFLORERT" is written in small text below the lower object on the page.
title: Spurs
